name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments of Rs 2,000, paid to the bank account.
who: Land-holding farmer families. Not for income-tax payers, institutional land holders, most pensioners and professionals.
how: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or the nearest CSC with Aadhaar, bank account and land record; e-KYC is required.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
benefit: Insurance against crop loss. Farmer premium: 2% of sum insured for kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for rabi, 5% for commercial and horticultural crops.
who: All farmers (owners and tenants) growing notified crops in notified areas.
how: Enrol before the season cut-off through your bank, a CSC, the Crop Insurance app or pmfby.gov.in. Report local losses within 72 hours (helpline 14447).

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Short-term crop loans; with the interest subvention and prompt-repayment incentive the effective rate is about 4% a year.
who: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers and self-help groups.
how: Apply at any bank branch with land/tenancy record and ID. Ask the bank for the current loan limit.

name: Per Drop More Crop (micro-irrigation subsidy)
benefit: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler systems: 55% for small and marginal farmers, 45% for others (states may add more).
who: Farmers who want to install drip or sprinkler irrigation.
how: Apply through the state horticulture / micro-irrigation department (in Andhra Pradesh: APMIP).

name: PM-KUSUM (solar pumps)
benefit: Standalone solar pumps with central and state support (typically 30% + 30%; farmer pays the rest, bank loan possible).
who: Farmers using diesel or grid pumps, or without irrigation.
how: Apply through the state renewable energy agency when applications open.

name: Soil Health Card
benefit: Free soil test with fertilizer advice for your field.
how: Ask your agriculture office or Rythu Seva Kendra for soil sampling; add the card to Kshetra for exact fertilizer doses.

name: e-NAM (online mandi)
benefit: Sell to buyers across mandis online and get paid to your bank account.
how: Register at enam.gov.in or at the mandi with ID and bank details.

name: Annadata Sukhibhava (Andhra Pradesh)
benefit: Rs 20,000 a year per farmer family (Rs 14,000 state + Rs 6,000 PM-KISAN), in instalments. Check current rules.
who: Land-owning farmers, tenant farmers with a CCRC card, and Forest Rights Act land cultivators in Andhra Pradesh.
how: Check status at annadathasukhibhava.ap.gov.in or your Rythu Seva Kendra; Aadhaar-linked bank account and e-KYC needed.
